Please help us rejuvenate Washington DC’s emerging neighborhoods! Eric Colbert + Associates (ECA) is an established architecture firm in Washington, DC specializing in exciting multifamily residential architecture throughout the Washington area and beyond.
We are looking for architects/designers with 8-10 years experience. Candidates should have the ability to multi-task, be self-motivated, detail-oriented, have good written and verbal communication skills, and be able to work independently. Candidates with proficiency in Revit are strongly preferred. Working knowledge of SketchUp, Rhino, the Adobe Creative Suite, Bluebeam, Lumion, Enscape, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office is a plus.
The candidate will work on project teams of 2 to 6 people and will have the potential to work on all phases of projects from schematic design, design development, construction documentation, to construction administration.
Our firm offers great benefits including a matching 401K, HDHP Medical-Dental-Vision health care plan with HSA, and Metro SmartBenefits.
Please note that initial interviews will be done via video conference.
Please send your resume and portfolio samples (no larger than 8MB) to [email protected] with the subject line “Project Architect Position”.
